description: A pure invoice status derivation in packages/billing/src/lib/balanceDue.ts takes total, credit applied, net payments and current lifecycle status, and returns paid / partially_applied / sent while never overwriting draft, cancelled or void
recordExternalPayment (record and reverse paths) uses the shared derivation in place of its private resolveStatus, with unchanged behaviour

finalizeInvoiceWithKnex writes the derived status (from net recorded payments) instead of hard-coded 'sent', for every caller (UI action, REST InvoiceService, recurring generation, prepaid auto-replenishment)
The invoice_finalized audit row records the derived status in after.status
Post-finalize credit auto-apply computes headroom with computeBalanceDue (net of payments), so a paid invoice draws no client credit
Credit application sets invoice status through the shared derivation (it did not write status before; it now does, so payments plus credit covering the total read paid)
Credit notes, negative-total and prepayment invoices with no payments keep their current post-finalize status (paid requires net payments > 0)
A draft invoice with recorded payments shows the net amount paid, using getInvoicePaymentSummary
A draft invoice whose total is below its recorded payments shows a warning that finalizing will leave it overpaid
New UI strings for F008/F009 are added to every msp/invoicing locale file
A Citus-safe migration recomputes status for finalized, non-cancelled, non-void invoices with recorded payments whose stored status disagrees with the derivation; drafts are untouched
